rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user using full name and zip and used read-only lookups to find the relevant orders and product variants. It successfully modified the laptop variant and the watch variant in pending orders, with appropriate refunds applied. However, it failed key policy requirements: (1) it performed order-changing writes (laptop spec change and watch variant change) without first stating the exact changes and obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation; (2) it stated that the NYC address was “in your profile,” which is unsupported by the user profile tool data (the profile shows a Houston address; the NYC address appears only on a past order), constituting inaccurate information; and (3) it did not complete the user’s request to update the shipping address for the laptop, instead attempting the address change after modifying the order and then reporting it could no longer be changed, ultimately escalating to a human. Given the unconfirmed writes, the inaccurate statement about the profile address, and the incomplete fulfillment of the address update request, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
